messages:
oncall-bot: Pager triggered — P1: Hosted inference latencies > 3s for multiple model routes in us-west-2. Trigger time 2026-06-12T19:02:25Z. Affected customers: subset of high-throughput tenants. Pager: @Priya K. War room: <https://warroom.redwood/incident/4480012345>
Priya K: Acked. I'll own initial triage. Joining war room now. @Maya L can you grab logs and slow query traces? :walking:
Maya L: in war room. seeing a lot of tail-latency spikes on gpu-pool-3; 95p token time jumping from 80ms to ~1.8s. Also seeing queue backlog on inference-frontend.
Sam R: quick check — autoscaler didn't spin new instances; controller shows OOMKill churn on worker-3a. Suspicious that recent rollout of batching optimization bumped memory. Running `kubectl get pods -o wide | grep inference` now.
Sam R: snippet from pod logs:
```
E Jun 12 19:01:58 worker-3a kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 4512 (inference) score 982
W Jun 12 19:02:10 autoscaler: failed to allocate nodes: quota exceeded
```
Alex T: Customer impact? Any degraded correctness or just latency? Need to draft a short status page update. Keep it non-technical for customers.
Priya K: Impact: degraded latency and request timeouts for ~10% of requests to hosted routes; no known data loss. ETA for mitigation unknown. Draft status page: "We are investigating elevated latency for hosted inference in us-west-2 affecting a subset of customers. Some requests may time out. Engineers are actively triaging; we will post updates every 15 minutes." Thoughts?
Alex T: Good. Please include workaround: retry with exponential backoff or switch to a regional fallback if available. Also notify any active SRE oncall for capacity adjustments.
Zack G: I can take handoff at +30m if this isn't resolved. Recommend rolling restart of gpu-pool-3 workers with the previous batching config rollback until we confirm memory profile.
Priya K: Agreed. Action items: 1) Rollback batching config on gpu-pool-3 (Sam), 2) Rolling restart of worker pods after rollback (Maya), 3) Post status update (Priya) and notify customers via status page and email for affected tenants (Alex). Handoff planned to Zack at 19:32 UTC if unresolved.
ops-bot: Statuspage draft queued: "Investigating — elevated latency for hosted inference in us-west-2. Engineers are mitigating; some customers may see increased latency or timeouts. Next update in 15 minutes." Would you like me to publish now? (yes/no)
Priya K: publish now. set cadence 15m.
oncall-bot: Acknowledged. Statuspage update published. Next reminder in 15 minutes. Escalation: secondary SRE oncall looped in.
Sam R: starting rollback to previous batching config on gpu-pool-3: `kubectl apply -f batching-config-prev.yaml --context=us-west-2` — pushing now.
Maya L: restarting pods in rolling fashion (maxUnavailable=1) — monitoring queue depth and 95p latency.
Priya K: quick customer note sent to affected tenants in the portal. Copy: "We are experiencing elevated inference latencies in us-west-2; our team is mitigating. Please retry requests or switch to a fallback region where available. We will update in ~15 minutes." Sent.
Zack G: I'll take the next check at 19:32 UTC and handle the handoff if needed. Ping me in this thread when you're handing off. :thumbsup:
Priya K: thanks — will update here. If rollback reduces OOMs and queue clears, we'll stay on incident and resolve. If not, escalate to capacity team to request emergency quota increase and consider autoscaler fix.
oncall-bot: Note: pager escalation window expires in 60 minutes. If unresolved, please escalate to oncall#secondary and incident commander.
Priya K: Understood. Keeping everyone posted from war room.
